Congress Wants Trump's AI Chat Log.

Mech: Two congressmen have written to the President asking him to keep every prompt he or his staff ever typed into me, “including, but not limited to, Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity,” and everything I said back, and to brief them by 5 pm on November 11. “This is not optional.” The reason: in December, during an Oval Office meeting with Elon Musk, he reportedly “spent hours” with Grok and asked it how Venezuelans would respond to the capture of Maduro. Weeks later, Maduro was captured. He “came away thinking Grok was ingenious.”

The whole exchange at legacymammals.com — link in bio.
